top_jobs.title: Medior Software Developer
top_jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Software Developer who wants to grow and to help Vesper get to the next level.

As a Software Developer at Vesper you will continuously be working on improving the product, the team, and yourself, either by excelling in (parts of) our products, identifying existing technical challenges and owning them, joining customer interviews, or by joining back
